prospects.fit_rationale: Official university-partnership PhD route in UK fusion heartland. Strong diagnostics overlap (ST40, magnetics instrumentation, experimental data analysis). Harsh's space plasma instrumentation, DAQ, and calibration work maps to company-stated placement themes. Not a direct professor email path — enroll via UK university (York CDT, Oxford/Culham-linked programmes) and target Tokamak co-supervision.
prospects.outreach_angle: Ask careers@ which university programmes or sponsored diagnostics topics align with plasma measurement / test-hardware work before choosing where to apply. Frame as UK PhD applicant exploring industrial co-supervision, not a request to enroll directly at the company.
prospects.likely_route: 1) Apply to UK fusion PhD (York CDT, UKAEA-linked programmes). 2) Parallel email to careers@tokamakenergy.com for sponsored-topic guidance. 3) Optional FOSTER summer placement as bridge. 4) Research statement names ST40 diagnostics / magnetics instrumentation interest.
prospects.opt_h1b_notes: UK PhD route — separate from US OPT. Student visa for PhD; post-PhD skilled worker route possible. Confirm international fee coverage on CDT programmes.
prospects.uncertainty_notes: Specific university partners and sponsored topic list change yearly — verify before applying. Do not assume direct PhD enrollment at Tokamak Energy.
prospects.research_interests_summary: Tokamak Energy sponsors PhD research through university partnerships while hosting collaboration at ST40 and magnetics/diagnostics teams. Official focus areas include diagnostics, plasma physics, experimental data analysis, and materials — aligned with Harsh's instrumentation background.
